job.title: Junior AI Application Engineer, AI Products (LLM & RAG)

strengths: Python development and AI research experience
Hands-on leadership in building AI prototypes and micro-services
Experience with NLP, LLM evaluation and backend web development
gaps: No explicit cloud deployment or Kubernetes experience

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a strong background in AI research and practical software development. At Toros University I led a department while co-founding SmartLab Technology Center, where I built AI prototypes for medical text summarisation and managed full-stack web projects using Python, HTML, JavaScript and PHP. My recent work on trustworthy NLP and LLM-based evaluation metrics gives me solid experience with large language models and retrieval-augmented generation concepts.

I have designed and deployed micro-services for AI applications, integrated APIs, and built scalable back-end components for academic and startup projects. My hands-on approach to prototyping and moving solutions to production matches the focus of your AI Application Engineer role.

I look forward to contributing to Machine Learning Reply's AI products, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and expanding my cloud deployment and DevOps skills while delivering reliable, user-centric AI systems.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
short_pitch: I combine AI research with practical software engineering. I led a university department and co-founded a tech centre where I built NLP prototypes and full-stack services using Python and web technologies. My work on LLM evaluation and retrieval-augmented summarisation prepares me to develop scalable AI applications and micro-services for enterprise use.

answers.why_this_role: The role blends AI engineering with product development, which matches my experience building AI prototypes and turning research into usable software. I enjoy turning model capabilities into real-world applications.
answers.why_this_organisation: Machine Learning Reply's focus on bringing advanced AI to business matches my goal of delivering trustworthy AI solutions that have practical impact.
answers.relevant_experience: I led AI projects on trustworthy NLP, created LLM-based evaluation tools, and built backend services for academic platforms. I also managed a tech centre, coordinating development teams and delivering prototypes to users.
answers.research_interests: My research centers on explainable AI, trustworthy NLP, and hybrid summarisation methods that combine extractive techniques with large language models.
answers.additional_information: I have experience mentoring diverse teams, participating in international AI summer schools, and holding patents on AI-enabled hardware, demonstrating a blend of research and applied innovation.
